summary: AVITA Medical filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register up to 650,000 shares of common stock issuable upon exercise of a warrant granted to Perceptive Credit Holdings under a January 2026 credit agreement. The warrant exercise would yield ~$2.2M in proceeds at $4.36 last-sale. This is a routine shelf takedown/registration of securities, not a special-situation event. The company is the issuer, and there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situations dynamic. The filing is a standard capital markets transaction with no extraordinary corporate action.
